subject: Blickle - Order confirmation 6092735
body_content:
Dear Sir/Madam

Many thanks for ordering from Blickle. We will process your order as quickly as possible. Please note that this is only
confirmation that we have received your order. It is not confirmation that your order has been accepted and that a purchase
agreement has been concluded. This agreement will be concluded when we send you an order confirmation.

That confirmation will include the items in your order, the contact information for your contact partner and (if applicable)
our bank details for advance payments.

If you have any questions about your order, you can contact your personal contact partner at any time:
https://www.blickle.co.uk/services/contact-search

Our general terms and conditions are available here: https://www.blickle.co.uk/general-terms-and-conditions


Yours sincerely

Blickle Castors & Wheels Limited
Blickle House, Presley Way
Crownhill, Milton Keynes MK8 0ES
Phone: 01908 56 09 04
www.blickle.co.uk
